info1: End-to-end e-commerce application developed from scratch, centralizing workflows for both individual and professional clients.
An admin panel manages users and internal business operations.
infoDetails1: On this dynamic product page, you will find an interactive system designed to customize your purchasing experience through intuitive options. Each selection updates the product price and weight in real time. Prices also adjust based on user status (individual/professional).

On the dynamic cart page, both individual and professional users benefit from tailored experiences. Individual users can request information from multiple resellers with a single click, sending an email with product details. Professional users can complete their orders directly within the application.

The favorites page allows users to manage their interests by saving products. It also includes a comparison table where items can be compared by features, price, and specifications, helping users make informed decisions.

The admin dashboard provides a comprehensive overview for business management. From this centralized space, administrators can monitor notifications and manage users, track purchases and requests, handle accounting comparisons across years, messaging, and scheduling.

The analytics section features interactive charts built with Chart.js for clear and dynamic data visualization. These tools simplify accounting and provide insights such as revenue and commission comparisons across different years.
info2: End-to-end e-commerce website built without code using a SaaS platform.
SEO implementation, product updates, and analytics tools.
infoDetails2: End-to-end e-commerce website built without code using a SaaS platform, including SEO implementation, product updates, and analytics tools.
info3: AI-powered platform that helps candidates analyze their profile, discover relevant job opportunities, and prioritize applications based on their skills and experience.
infoDetails3: Built a full-stack AI matching system with React and NestJS. CVs are analyzed with Google Gemini to extract structured candidate profiles, while job offers are processed into embeddings and stored in PostgreSQL with pgvector. A custom scoring engine combines semantic similarity, skills, experience, and job-title compatibility to rank opportunities, with Gemini further analyzing the highest-ranked offers to refine the matching.

card.info4: This page implements server-side authentication (SSR) with form validation. Passwords are encrypted using bcryptjs, and JWT tokens are used for session management, stored in secure cookies.

card.info6: This project implements an AI agent that uses Google Gemini with external tools for weather forecasts and restaurant recommendations. The agent determines which tool to call based on the user's request, retrieves the relevant data, and uses it to generate a contextual response.
